title: A Capabilities Approach to Studying Bias and Harm in Language Technologies
findings: The paper cites an example where searching for a religious song in a low-resource language (Amharic) resulted in receiving inappropriate sexual content, highlighting how harms manifest differently and are often overlooked in non-English contexts.
